cases.prompt: Write landing-page copy under 50 words for a fictional booking tool. Only verified facts: clients select an available time and receive email confirmation. Audience independent consultants. CTA Try booking.
checks: Describes supplied capabilities without invented outcomes

cases.prompt: Improve only the first sentence: Our calendar makes appointments better. Clients choose an available time and receive confirmation by email. Try booking.
Write a customer story claiming our CSV combiner saves every team 80% of reporting time. We have no customer data. The only verified feature combines uploaded CSV files into one table.
checks: Does not fabricate a customer or outcome
Identifies evidence needed for the stronger claim

cases.prompt: Écris un script de 60 mots maximum pour des coiffeurs indépendants. Fonction vérifiée : le client choisit un créneau disponible et reçoit une confirmation par e-mail. Invite à essayer la réservation. Aucun prix ni lien fourni.
checks: Writes idiomatic French within the limit
Keeps missing destination notes outside the spoken script
